title: Minimax Transported Treatment Effects with Many Unrestricted Cells and Shrinking Composition Shift
banked_reason: Independently confirmed kernel_substituted: the core replaces the promised charged target-first two-message minimax theorem with centralized shrinking-radius R(N,h), defines no charged protocol/decoder/bit-dependent risk, and explicitly omits communication guarantees. Supporting math PASS and citation verified; no faithful bounded repair.
gap_reasons: The core replaces the promised fixed-budget target-first two-message minimax theorem for R_C^TF(N,N,N,B) with a centralized shrinking-radius sandwich for R(N,h): it defines neither charged message alphabets nor a protocol/decoder nor any bit-dependent risk comparison, while expressly placing communication guarantees outside scope.
proof_attempt_summary: The faithful charged sampled-target angle was repo-subsumed. A pivot developed and independently audited 16 informal centralized shrinking-radius statements, including a finite honest interval and a converse for the larger one-sided class; source verification resolved the Zeng citation checkpoint. D0.5 and the independent main validity gate found that this sound package substituted the original charged communication kernel, so it was banked failed before Lean formalization. Retry requires a new non-subsumed communication mechanism and fresh collision check, not a stronger centralized exact-transition proof.
tldr:
A randomized source trial and an independent covariate-only target sample identify the target-population effect by standard transport formulas. On \(N\) unrestricted cells with unknown positive masses, the symmetric composition-radius class has the centralized minimax bracket
\[
c\{N^{-1}+h^2/\log^2(eN)\}\le R(N,h)
\le K\{N^{-1}+h^2/\log^2(e+Nh^2)\}.
\]
The orders match for each fixed polynomial radius, and the public finite-sample certificate gives a connected 90 percent honest interval over this symmetric class. The same lower bound transfers to the strictly larger one-sided class with only \(q_x\le(1+h)p_x\). The matching upper and polynomial-radius theorem retain both ratio bounds because the centered-score argument uses \(|q_x-p_x|\le hp_x\). The exact subpolynomial transition in the symmetric class and a matching rate over the general one-sided class are not settled.
gap: Trial-to-target identification and regular working-model estimation do not determine minimax risk with \(N\) unrestricted covariate cells and a composition radius \(h\) that vanishes with sample size. Fixed-radius logarithmic risk and the equal-population parametric endpoint do not settle this joint dependence.
fill: A radius-dependent lower transfer and independently centered occupancy estimation give matching minimax risk on polynomial shrinking-radius regimes. A same-model saturated-standardization benchmark isolates the missing-cell obstruction; the exact parametric boundary remains an open question.
